description: This module allows you to create, update, or delete Keycloak User Profiles using the Keycloak API. You can also customize the “Unmanaged Attributes” with it.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_keycloak_url
parameters.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The configuration of the User Profile Provider.

parameters.name: kc_user_profile_config
parameters.description: Define a declarative User Profile. See EXAMPLES for more context.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: A list of attributes to be included in the User Profile.

parameters.name: annotations
parameters.description: Annotations for the attribute.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: The display name of the attribute.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Specifies the User Profile group where this attribute is added.

parameters.name: multivalued
parameters.description: Whether the attribute can have multiple values. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the attribute.

parameters.name: permissions
parameters.description: The permissions for viewing and editing the attribute.

parameters.name: edit
parameters.description: The roles that can edit the attribute. Supported values are admin and user. Default: ["admin", "user"]

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: The roles that can view the attribute. Supported values are admin and user. Default: ["admin", "user"]

parameters.name: required
parameters.description: The roles that require this attribute.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: The roles for which this attribute is required. Supported values are admin and user. Default: ["user"]

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Selector when the attribute should be added.

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Scopes to which the attribute should be added.

parameters.name: validations
parameters.description: The validations to be applied to the attribute.

parameters.name: double
parameters.description: The double validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: integer
parameters.description: The integer validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: iso_date
parameters.description: The iso-date validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum length of the attribute.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum length of the attribute.

parameters.name: local_date
parameters.description: The local-date validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Validation to ensure the attribute matches one of the provided options.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: The pattern validation for the attribute using regular expressions.

parameters.name: person_name_prohibited_characters
parameters.description: The prohibited characters validation for person name attributes.

parameters.name: up_username_not_idn_homograph
parameters.description: The validation to prevent IDN homograph attacks in usernames.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: The URI validation for the attribute.

parameters.name: username_prohibited_characters
parameters.description: The prohibited characters validation for the username attribute.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: A list of attribute groups to be included in the User Profile.

parameters.name: display_description
parameters.description: The display description for the group.

parameters.name: display_header
parameters.description: The display header for the group.

parameters.name: unmanaged_attribute_policy
parameters.description: Policy for unmanaged attributes. Choices: "ENABLED" "ADMIN_EDIT" "ADMIN_VIEW"

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: The parent ID of the realm key. In practice the ID (name) of the realm.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: The name of the provider ID for the key (supported value is declarative-user-profile). Choices: "declarative-user-profile" ← (default)

parameters.name: provider_type
parameters.description: Component type for User Profile (only supported value is org.keycloak.userprofile.UserProfileProvider). Choices: "org.keycloak.userprofile.UserProfileProvider" ← (default)

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the User Profile provider. On present, the User Profile provider is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On absent, the User Profile provider is removed if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a Declarative User Profile with default settings
  community.general.keycloak_userprofile:
    state: present
    parent_id: master
    config:
      kc_user_profile_config:
        - attributes:
            - name: username
              displayName: ${username}
              validations:
                length:
                  min: 3
                  max: 255
                username_prohibited_characters: {}
                up_username_not_idn_homograph: {}
              annotations: {}
              permissions:
                view:
                  - admin
                  - user
                edit: []
              multivalued: false
            - name: email
              displayName: ${email}
              validations:
                email: {}
                length:
                  max: 255
              annotations: {}
              required:
                roles:
                  - user
              permissions:
                view:
                  - admin
                  - user
                edit: []
              multivalued: false
            - name: firstName
              displayName: ${firstName}
              validations:
                length:
                  max: 255
                person_name_prohibited_characters: {}
              annotations: {}
              required:
                roles:
                  - user
              permissions:
                view:
                  - admin
                  - user
                edit: []
              multivalued: false
            - name: lastName
              displayName: ${lastName}
              validations:
                length:
                  max: 255
                person_name_prohibited_characters: {}
              annotations: {}
              required:
                roles:
                  - user
              permissions:
                view:
                  - admin
                  - user
                edit: []
              multivalued: false
            - name: testAttribute
              displayName: ${testAttribute}
              validations:
                integer:
                  min: 0
                  max: 255
              annotations: {}
              required:
                roles:
                  - user
              permissions:
                view:
                  - admin
                  - user
                edit: []
              multivalued: false
          groups:
            - name: user-metadata
              displayHeader: User metadata
              displayDescription: Attributes, which refer to user metadata
              annotations: {}

- name: Delete a Keycloak User Profile Provider
  keycloak_userprofile:
    state: absent
    parent_id: master

# Unmanaged attributes are user attributes not explicitly defined in the User Profile
# configuration. By default, unmanaged attributes are "Disabled" and are not
# available from any context such as registration, account, and the
# administration console. By setting "Enabled", unmanaged attributes are fully
# recognized by the server and accessible through all contexts, useful if you are
# starting migrating an existing realm to the declarative User Profile
# and you don't have yet all user attributes defined in the User Profile configuration.
- name: Enable Unmanaged Attributes
  community.general.keycloak_userprofile:
    state: present
    parent_id: master
    config:
      kc_user_profile_config:
        - unmanagedAttributePolicy: ENABLED

# By setting "Only administrators can write", unmanaged attributes can be managed
# only through the administration console and API, useful if you have already
# defined any custom attribute that can be managed by users but you are unsure
# about adding other attributes that should only be managed by administrators.
- name: Enable ADMIN_EDIT on Unmanaged Attributes
  community.general.keycloak_userprofile:
    state: present
    parent_id: master
    config:
      kc_user_profile_config:
        - unmanagedAttributePolicy: ADMIN_EDIT

# By setting `Only administrators can view`, unmanaged attributes are read-only
# and only available through the administration console and API.
- name: Enable ADMIN_VIEW on Unmanaged Attributes
  community.general.keycloak_userprofile:
    state: present
    parent_id: master
    config:
      kc_user_profile_config:
        - unmanagedAttributePolicy: ADMIN_VIEW

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: The data returned by the Keycloak API. Returned: when state is present

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: The output message generated by the module. Returned: always Sample: "UserProfileProvider created successfully"
